## Resource provenance (for resource proposals)

- Canonical upstream repository:
- Exact revision (40-character commit SHA):
- Original publisher / author:
- SPDX license identifier:
- Redistribution review:
- Source code or binaries included? (Initial proposals must answer no.)

Resource proposals belong under `contributions/inbox/<contribution-id>/`. Do not edit approved catalog records in the proposal PR.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No private repositories, private source, credentials, secrets, or personal data are included.
- [ ] No executable payloads, archives, vendored dependencies, or opaque binaries are included.
- [ ] No code is automatically installed or executed.
- [ ] Network destinations and required permissions are documented.
- [ ] License, attribution, and upstream notices are documented.
- [ ] Security implications and known limitations are documented.
- [ ] Local-first and offline implications are documented.
- [ ] No existing user data or local state can be overwritten silently.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] `pytest` passes.
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] Wheel build succeeds when package code changes.
- [ ] Documentation links and examples were checked.
- [ ] Limitations and untested platforms are stated accurately.
